purpose: Long-term source pool memory for Flow B Ozon China scanning. Use this to remember proven high-yield pools, switch away from exhausted pools, and discover new categories when current pools decay.

promote_to_main_pool_if: Two validation batches are available and average fav_per_min >= 8
Or one small validation has favorite_delta >= 15 with clean small-goods seller segment
Seller pool is not dominated by large goods, electronics brands, furniture, or heavy instruments
demote_or_stop_if: Fresh seller count after dedupe is below 3
Product source drifts into large goods, branded electronics, construction tools, medical items, strollers, bikes, pools, furniture, or heavy instruments
Seller extraction stalls: 10 relevant products produce 2 or fewer fresh sellers
Chrome/Maozi count is unavailable for two consecutive batches; pause and restore count before judging the pool
source_discovery_order: If main pool decays, try supplement pools
If supplement pools decay, explore watch pools by breadcrumb/category ids from successful products
Avoid exhausted and downweighted pools unless there is new evidence

pools.name: kids_toys_high_price_tail
seller_segment_features: Toy/BJD/RC/blocks stores
Children/toy China sellers in mid/tail windows, not broad front pages
Avoid outdoor large goods: electric cars, bikes, pools, strollers, furniture

observed_performance.recent_state: fresh pool exhausted; current 7108 products clean but seller pool concentrated

use_when: New fresh sellers can be found after path dedupe
Product mix remains toy/BJD/RC/blocks and seller extraction is not concentrated
stop_when: Page drifts into large children goods or generic products

pools.name: tabletop_card_games
seller_segment_features: Tabletop/card-game sellers
Small hobby goods
Search/filter product text for tabletop, card, DND, UNO, Bicycle, collectible-card terms
Prefer sellers like xiaoyu/studio101/lucky-star style tabletop stores

observed_performance.judgment: strongest clean new seller segment from 2026-06-18 discovery

use_when: Need clean small-goods source with high Maozi response
Product filtering can keep source in tabletop/card-game products
stop_when: Filtered products produce <= 2 fresh sellers after 10 products
Source drifts into apparel, instruments, tools, or unrelated broad hobby goods

pools.name: playing_cards_collectible_cards
seller_segment_features: Playing cards, collectible cards, UNO, Bicycle, Topps/Panini, DND-adjacent cards
Seller slugs often look like Chinese trading/company names
Product exploration itself can trigger Maozi auto-favorites

observed_performance.judgment: effective medium; use after tabletop or as paired source

use_when: Need more hobby small-goods sellers after tabletop source
Can filter product text to card/game terms before seller extraction
stop_when: Seller growth stalls around same few card sellers
Product pool drifts into apparel or unrelated low-quality goods

pools.name: default_min50_middle_window
seller_segment_features: Only middle source window; skip front and tail
Mixed small electronics/protective accessories/tech stores when source is favorable
Do not use broad front/bridge/tail as default
use_when: Main pools are exhausted and a controlled supplement is needed
Only scan known productive middle windows
stop_when: Source enters laptops, monitors, phones, bathroom, medical, or large goods

Handpick tabletop/hobby/creative sellers
Avoid musical-instrument, heavy gear, large tools, luggage, and unrelated tails

observed_performance.fav_per_min: unreliable due Chrome count timeout during partial scan

use_when: Need supplement volume after clean hobby/card pools
Can manually or programmatically filter seller/product text away from large goods
stop_when: Quality risk dominates small tabletop/creative goods

Constructors/figures/plush/toy-weapons current pages did not produce high favorite response

observed_performance.judgment: do not hard-scan until new evidence appears

revive_if: A new visible seller cluster appears
A different price window produces >= 8 fresh sellers and first batch delta >= 5

pools.name: broad_low_quality_or_large_goods
category_names: Paint by numbers for seller scanning
seller_segment_features: Large electronics, construction tools, medical/e-bike/razor drift, pets/category drift, large kids goods, seller extraction failure, or broad mixed accessories

observed_performance.judgment: avoid as default; only revisit with specific new filtered product signal

revive_if: A specific subcategory/product breadcrumb has proven seller delta >= 10
Broad page can be filtered to clean small-goods sellers before scanning

switch_logic: Run the current main pool until fresh sellers < 3 or two low-yield batches occur.
If main pool decays, move to the next main pool in order.
If all main pools decay, scan supplement pools with strict filtering and early stop.
If supplement pools decay or become quality-risk heavy, use watch pools only for product/category discovery, then create a new candidate pool from breadcrumbs.
Promote a new candidate to main only after validation exceeds current supplement performance.
new_category_discovery_logic: Open products that caused favorite growth.
Extract breadcrumb category IDs from product detail pages.
Create a China-highlight URL with that category ID.
Collect products, filter product text to the target segment, then extract sellers.
Validate 1-3 small batches and record favorite_delta and fav_per_min.
Promote, watch, downweight, or mark exhausted based on validation.
